prespecifiedDecisionRule.rule: Default to BALANCED only if BALANCED > FAST on held-out oracle completion rate (or equal completion with lower token and latency cost); otherwise default to FAST.
prespecifiedDecisionRule.rationale: Under the prespecified evaluation rule, BALANCED (80% oracle completion, 2402 mean input tokens, 6342ms latency) did not outperform FAST (80% oracle completion, 1734 mean input tokens, 4867ms latency); therefore FAST is selected as the default mode, with BALANCED and STRICT available as opt-in verification modes.
